content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure of NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that empowers creators to take control of their payment processing. Unlike traditional payment processors, this combination does not rely on a single platform or technology, but instead uses a decentralized approach that ensures creators own their infrastructure and data. With NOWPayments, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, and with Cloudflare Workers, they can automate their payment processing, reducing manual errors and increasing efficiency. The result is a payment pipeline that is not only faster but also more secure and reliable than traditional payment processors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying this infrastructure, creators need to ensure they have the necessary tools and knowledge. This includes a Cloudflare account, a NOWPayments account, and a basic understanding of Cloudflare Workers and JavaScript. Additionally, creators should have a digital product to sell and a payment method configured in their NOWPayments account. With these prerequisites in place, creators can move forward with setting up their payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up the payment and delivery pipeline involves several steps. First, creators need to configure their NOWPayments account to accept USDT payments on Tron or Solana. Next, they need to set up a Cloudflare Workers script to automate their payment processing, including verifying payments and updating order status. Finally, creators need to configure their file delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure seamless delivery of their digital products.
With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, creators can receive USDT payments on Tron and Solana in under $0.10 in network fees, and fractions of a cent per transaction.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once the payment and delivery pipeline is set up, creators can go live and start processing transactions. With NOWPayments, creators can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, and with Cloudflare Workers, they can automate their payment processing. To process the first transaction, creators need to manually trigger the Cloudflare Workers script, which will verify the payment and update the order status. From there, creators can monitor their transactions and adjust their infrastructure as needed.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As creators grow their business, they may need to scale their infrastructure to accommodate increasing traffic and transaction volume. To scale, creators can use Cloudflare's built-in caching and load balancing features to improve performance, and NOWPayments' advanced analytics to monitor and optimize their transactions. Additionally, creators can use Edge Commerce Stack ($197), a pre-configured infrastructure solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, to simplify the scaling process.

How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal? With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, USDT payments on Tron and Solana take under $0.10 in network fees and average fractions of a cent per transaction, significantly faster than PayPal's P2P conversion, which can take several days or even weeks to process a single transaction. Additionally, NOWPayments' automated payment processing ensures that creators receive payments instantly, without the need to wait for manual processing.
NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee for all transactions, making it a cost-effective option for creators.

Visit the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, follow these steps: Create a Cloudflare account and a NOWPayments account; Configure your NOWPayments account to accept USDT payments on Tron or Solana; Set up a Cloudflare Workers script to automate payment processing; Configure your file delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; Trigger the Cloudflare Workers script manually to process the first transaction; Monitor transactions and adjust infrastructure as needed; Scale infrastructure using Cloudflare's caching and load balancing features and NOWPayments' advanced analytics.
Frequently Asked Questions
What happens if I encounter issues with the payment and delivery pipeline?

If you encounter issues with the payment and delivery pipeline, troubleshoot by checking Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments logs for errors, and adjust your configuration as needed. If the issue persists, contact NOWPayments support for assistance. Additionally, consider consulting the COREMERCH knowledge base or posting in the Cloudflare community forum for help.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell digital products on other platforms?

Yes, you can use this infrastructure to sell digital products on other platforms, including social media, your website, or other online marketplaces. Simply configure your NOWPayments account to accept payments and set up your Cloudflare Workers script to automate payment processing.
How do I update my NOWPayments account to accept new cryptocurrencies?

To update your NOWPayments account to accept new cryptocurrencies, log in to your account, navigate to the 'Cryptocurrencies' tab, and select the new cryptocurrency you want to add. Follow the prompts to complete the setup process.
What are the transaction fees for using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee for all transactions, making it a cost-effective option for creators. Additionally, USDT payments on Tron and Solana incur under $0.10 in network fees, and Solana transaction fees average fractions of a cent per transaction.
Can I integrate NOWPayments with other payment processors?
Yes, you can integrate NOWPayments with other payment processors, such as PayPal or Stripe, using NOWPayments' API. This allows you to accept multiple payment methods and expand your customer base.
How do I verify payments with Cloudflare Workers?

To verify payments with Cloudflare Workers, use the NOWPayments API to check the payment status and update the order status accordingly. You can also use Cloudflare's built-in logging and monitoring features to track payment processing and identify any issues.
Can I use Cloudflare Workers to automate payment processing for multiple payment methods?

Yes, you can use Cloudflare Workers to automate payment processing for multiple payment methods, including USDT on Tron and Solana, and other cryptocurrencies supported by NOWPayments. Simply configure your NOWPayments account and set up separate Cloudflare Workers scripts for each payment method.
